text:
jon: heads up — noticed quota dashboard showing other orgs' usage on canary. Screenshot in thread. @maria @samir can you take a look?

maria: ack — seeing same on prod-canary, metrics for org 42 show up under org 7's view :confused:

samir: repro steps: click org switcher -> open Usage -> set timeframe -> results include rows with different org ids

elaine: any recent router/edge changes? we rolled the route-affinity header update yesterday

jon: rolled header change that switched to `X-Org-Affinity` -> `X-Org-ID` last night in canary

samir: looks like console's telemetry ingestion uses `X-Org-ID` but our internal router still sends `X-Org-Affinity` — mismatch on downstream attributer

ken: confirmed in logs: proxy forwarded `X-Org-Affinity: 7` but trace shows telemetry bonded to 42

maria: snippet from proxy logs:
```
[2025-07-23T02:15:10Z] proxy id=abcd headers={"X-Org-Affinity":"7", "X-Request-Id":"req-01"}
```

samir: but metrics-ingest shows attribution tag `org_id=42` — I think the attributer service falls back to session cookie when header absent, and session cookie belonged to 42

jon: root cause hypothesis: header rename created a short window where some frontends set new header, others read old; the attributer service uses a header priority list that still includes old name and then falls back incorrectly

maria: mitigation: update attributer to accept both header names and prefer the new one, plus add a sanity check in dashboard aggregators to drop cross-org rows pre-rollout

elaine: canary rollback? we currently have 4% of traffic on canary — maybe easier to rollback until patch

ken: rollback will be disruptive for canary metrics by itself but ok for quick mitigation

samir: I'll draft a small patch to attributer, add tests for header permutations, and a migration that tolerates both headers for 72h

jon: plan: (1) rollback canary now, (2) patch attributer in canary, (3) promote if green. Schedule hotfix window 03:30 UTC to minimize impact. @infra-bot please create incident and runbook

infra-bot: incident created: INC-20250723-42, runbook attached. Pager duty ping sent.

maria: adding telemetry owners and console product to followup for UX comms — users saw wrong quota numbers, need customer comms

jon: thanks all. samir on patch + PR, maria will draft comms. I'll own canary rollback.
